question: If x varies inversely as y³ - 1 and is equal to 4 when y = 3, find x when y = 9.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For inverse variation, the product of the variables is constant: x₁(y₁³ − 1) = x₂(y₂³ − 1)

Substitute the given values directly into the constant product equation:

4 × (3³ − 1) = x × (9³ − 1)

4 × 26 = x × 728

x = 104 ÷ 728 = 1/7

**∴ The correct answer is 1/7.**
